lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: Hi! I'm Dimas, a developer at Nusa Digital. Just call me Dimas.

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: At this desk you really code in Python. Edit the code, press Run Tests, until every test is green.

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: There are also pull requests to review: APPROVE, REVISE, or ESCALATE. And now and then a CTF challenge: find the flag!

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: The fewer tries, the higher your score. But relax, mistakes are part of coding.

lines.speaker: dimas
lines.text: First shift done! You fixed bugs, wrote a function, and cracked a cipher. Nice.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: A new developer, hm... Let's hope you read pull requests carefully too.
